title: Coherence Neuro Raises $45M for Brain Implants That Learn
summary:
The OpenAI Startup Fund and Founders Fund co-led a funding round for a neurotechnology venture targeting malignant growths in the brain. Coherence Neuro raised $45 million to develop AI models and brain implants designed to monitor tumors and adjust therapies in real time, bypassing the slower assessment methods used in traditional oncology.

The company aims to establish "cancer therapy that learns" by using brain-computer interface platforms to create rapid data loops. By feeding real-time disease progression data back into the treatment system, Coherence Neuro intends to create medicine that continuously improves its own performance, a shift from the static nature of conventional drugs.
